The petitioner is challenging the Award dated 25.09.2023 passed by respondent No.3 in respect of payment of compensation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
2. The petitioner has submitted an application under Section 64 of the Act seeking reference to the Collector, Burhanpur for enhancement of compensation.
According to petitioner, the said application dated 26.09.2013 is pending before the Collector, Burhanpur.
